thread:
liam: handing off to @sasha for the evening. quick watchlist below, nothing critical but worth eyeballing.

liam: KV-prefetch alert has been noisy for the past 2 hours — increased retry rate but requests still succeeding. avoid mass-prefetching during low-memory windows. :warning:

sasha: noted. do we have a quick metric to watch?

liam: watch `kv.prefetch.retry_rate` and `kv.cache.hit_pct` in the infra dashboard. if retry_rate > 5/s for > 5m, escalate to eng-infra.

marta: encoder pool saw intermittent restarts on two nodes at 21:12/21:35. pods recovered automatically but tail-latency ticked up ~30ms.

jordan: is that the liveness probe flapping we saw earlier?

marta: maybe. logs show transient OOM on one pod, but we also had heavier short bursts of traffic from a rerun experiment.

liam: mitigation notes: 1) temporarily scale encoder pool +1 if tail > 200ms, 2) drop prefetch concurrency to 2 for suspect routes, 3) run `kubectl describe pod` and check `oom` traces.

sasha: got it. I'll keep autoscaler on and set a manual +1 if needed.

sasha: quick check command I ran earlier:```bash
# check encoder pod restarts and recent OOMs
kubectl get pods -l app=encoder -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount --sort-by=.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount
kubectl logs -p $(kubectl get pods -l app=encoder -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') --since=10m | grep -i oom
```

jordan: thanks — will monitor the alerts. also saw a flaky alert on route-rate-spike that fires for short bursts (false positives). filing a tune task tomorrow.

liam: FYI: if you see global fallback to n2-small model variant, it's expected during infra maintenance windows; don't pager unless sustained > 10m.

sasha: acknowledged. I'll ping if anything sustained or if retry rate keeps climbing. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: deploy finished for infra/kv-prefetch @ 2168001600 — rollout complete.

marta: thanks. leaving a short note in the oncall doc with the prefetch thresholds and links to dashboards.

liam: appreciate it — enjoy the rest of the evening. if anything odd, mention me or @jordan and we'll jump in.

sasha: will do.
